source_text: Sors non fortuna caeca; providentia Dei. Sortes apostolicae. Dominus disponit.
pass_a_gloss: Lot not fortune blind; providence of-God. Lots apostolic. Lord arranges.
pass_b_english: The lot is not blind fortune but God’s providence. Apostolic lots. The [[Lord arranges our steps >> Bible:Proverbs 16:33]].
